lore: Mind the season: the bar keeps a summer and a winter, same as the town.
almanac_note: The old hands' almanac gives the dark-moon and full-moon dates. The old hands go by the moon.
_numbers: v6, 2026-10-22 (final_v6.py -> final_v6.json; rhythms, sizes, today and the accepted dates from final_v5.json). The lagoon smooths out the twice-daily tide: moon = the moon's month 29.5306 d, sun = the season 365.25 d, nearfar = the moon's near-and-far stretched to 21.37 d (game simplification; the real anomalistic month is 27.55 d), wind = the afternoon southerly 24 h. z0 is the TRUE datum (3.54 m, recentred from v5's 3.672 so a hand-set datum can be off by -0.13..+0.14 m and still give 7-9 Dec); datum_start is the knocked-out datum the machine is found at (its first 3-day window, 10-15 Nov, is 1 m under water in truth). The town holds the moon and sun pulleys (town_pulleys); the player chooses near-and-far vs wind for the other two, and sets the datum, from the logbook (three soundings on half-metre lines; the wrong order misses one by >= 1.1 m with any datum). The haul length is never stated: bar_length_m / sledge_m_per_day = haul_days. Only dry stretch before today + 110 d: 1928-12-07 19:00 -> 12-12 12:00; accepted departure dates 7, 8, 9 Dec. Asserted in test_model.mjs.
